levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Three taḥwīl branches: the first two end at عبيد الله (the «قالا حدثنا عبيد الله» convergence); the third writes its full chain to the Companion
«- واللفظ له -» and «- يعني الثقفي -» are a wording note and an editor's gloss: left out
Doubt: the first two branches are not given nafi and ibn Umar in the text; they are carried only by the convergence at عبيد الله, not written
